title: L4 — τ²-bench pass^4 against ALTK-Evolve
notes: Source: /workspace/r49-fixtures/stub-paired.ts (driver form). Two arms must share the split.

No published pass^4 exists for τ²-airline, so this run is not graded against a leaderboard: ALTK-Evolve's 0.575 is a τ²-retail number, and comparing a airline run to it would report a difference between two scenarios as a difference the memory made. The comparison this run supports is the paired one.
pass^4 is the unbiased C(c,4)/C(n,4) mean over 2 tasks, with success defined as `reward == 1.0` exactly, as upstream scores it.
The split covers the minimum: 2 scored tasks against a floor of 1.

samples.criterion: against the same agent without the memory: delta >= 0 at p<0.05
a registered within-run pair is never a cross-run comparison
